contentHtml:
lemon coffee cake is a bright, cozy bake that brings a little sunshine to any morning. A soft, vanilla-kissed cake is swirled with tangy lemon curd, then crowned with a buttery cinnamon crumb that adds just the right touch of sweetness and warmth. Made with creamy yogurt and fresh lemon juice, it bakes up moist, tender, and full of citrusy flavor. Perfect for brunch, afternoon coffee breaks, or even dessert, lemon coffee cake is simple to make yet feels wonderfully special, guaranteed to bring smiles with every slice.

Why You’ll Love This lemon coffee cake

  • Bright, zesty flavor that wakes up your taste buds.
  • Perfectly moist texture that melts in your mouth.
  • Easy to make, even for beginner bakers.
  • Great for any occasion, from brunch to dessert.
  • Pairs beautifully with your favorite cup of coffee.

lemon coffee cake

Discover the perfect blend of flavors with our lemon coffee cake recipe! 🍋☕ A zesty treat that will brighten your day!

Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Dry Ingredients
  • 1½ cups all-purpose flour for the cake’s structure
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder helps the cake rise
  • ½ teaspoon baking soda additional leavening agent
  • ¼ teaspoon salt enhances flavor
Wet Ingredients
  • ½ cup unsalted butter softened for creaminess
  • 1 cup granulated sugar for sweetness
  • 2 large eggs binds the ingredients
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract adds warmth
  • ¼ cup fresh lemon juice brightens the cake
  • ½ cup sour cream keeps it moist
  • ½ cup strong brewed coffee enhances the flavor, cooled
  • ½ cup brown sugar adds rich sweetness
  • 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon a hint of spice
  • 2 tablespoons butter melted for topping

Equipment

  • 1 9-inch round cake pan Greased and floured for easy removal
  • 1 Medium Bowl For mixing dry ingredients
  • 1 large bowl For creaming butter and sugar

Method
 

Preparation
  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9-inch round cake pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.
Mix Dry Ingredients
  1. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. This will be the base of your cake.
Cream Butter and Sugar
  1. In a large bowl, beat softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. This step adds air to your batter!
Add Eggs and Flavor
  1. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla extract and lemon zest for that zesty flavor.
Combine Ingredients
  1. Alternate adding the dry ingredients with sour cream and lemon juice, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
Add Coffee
  1. Stir in cooled coffee until the batter is smooth. This adds a unique depth to your cake!
Layer the Batter
  1. Pour half of the batter into the prepared pan. In a small bowl, mix brown sugar, cinnamon, and melted butter, then sprinkle half over the batter. Top with the remaining batter and the remaining cinnamon sugar mixture.
Bake the Cake
  1. Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Your kitchen will smell amazing!
Cool and Serve
  1. Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before serving. Enjoy your delicious lemon coffee cake!

How to Make Lemon Coffee Cake

This delightful lemon coffee cake is perfect for any occasion! With a preparation time of 20 minutes, a cooking time of 35-40 minutes, and a cooling time of 10 minutes, you’ll have a zesty treat ready to impress your friends and family.

Step 1: Preheat the Oven

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9-inch round cake pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.

Step 2: Mix Dry Ingredients

In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. This will be the base of your cake.

Step 3: Cream Butter and Sugar

In a large bowl, beat softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. This step adds air to your batter!

Step 4: Add Eggs and Flavor

Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla extract and lemon zest for that zesty flavor.

Step 5: Combine Ingredients

Alternate adding the dry ingredients with sour cream and lemon juice, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.

Step 6: Add Coffee

Stir in cooled coffee until the batter is smooth. This adds a unique depth to your cake!

Step 7: Layer the Batter

Pour half of the batter into the prepared pan. In a small bowl, mix brown sugar, cinnamon, and melted butter, then sprinkle half over the batter. Top with the remaining batter and the remaining cinnamon sugar mixture.

Step 8: Bake the Cake

Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Your kitchen will smell amazing!

Step 9: Cool and Serve

Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before serving. Enjoy your delicious lemon coffee cake!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making Lemon Coffee Cake

  • Use fresh lemons for the best flavor and zest.
  • Let the cake cool completely before glazing for a smoother finish.
  • Incorporate sour cream for added moisture and richness.
  • Experiment with different citrus zests for a unique twist.
  • Store leftovers in an airtight container to keep it fresh longer.

How to Serve this lemon coffee cake

  • Enjoy a slice with a dollop of whipped cream on top.
  • Pair it with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for a delightful contrast.
  • Serve alongside a steaming cup of herbal tea for a cozy afternoon treat.
  • Top with fresh berries for a burst of color and flavor.
  • Drizzle with a simple lemon glaze for extra zesty sweetness.
  • Slice it into small squares for a perfect brunch buffet addition.

Make Ahead and Storage

You can make this cake ahead and store it easily:

Storing Leftovers

  • Allow the cake to cool completely.
  • Wrap it tightly in plastic wrap.
  • Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
  • For longer storage, refrigerate for up to a week.

Freezing

  • Wrap the cooled cake in plastic wrap and then in aluminum foil.
  • Label with the date and type of cake.
  • Freeze for up to 3 months for best quality.
  • Thaw in the refrigerator overnight before serving.

Reheating

  • Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
  • Place the cake on a baking sheet.
  • Cover loosely with foil to prevent over-browning.
  • Heat for about 10-15 minutes until warmed through.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. Can you mix coffee with lemon?

Yes, you can mix coffee with lemon! This combination is often enjoyed for its refreshing and zesty flavor. Adding a splash of lemon juice or a slice of lemon to your coffee can brighten the taste and provide a unique twist. It’s a great way to enhance your morning brew, especially if you enjoy citrus flavors!

2. What is the difference between a cake and a coffee cake?

The main difference between a cake and a coffee cake lies in their purpose and texture. Coffee cakes are typically designed to be enjoyed with coffee, often featuring a crumbly topping or streusel. They are usually less sweet than traditional cakes and may include flavors like cinnamon or fruit. In contrast, regular cakes are often sweeter and are usually served as desserts on their own. Both are delicious, but coffee cakes have that special touch for pairing with your favorite brew!

3. What culture puts lemon in coffee?

Adding lemon to coffee is a practice found in various cultures, particularly in some Mediterranean regions. For example, in Italy, it’s common to add a slice of lemon to espresso for a refreshing twist. This practice is also seen in parts of the Middle East, where coffee is often flavored with spices and citrus. It’s a delightful way to enjoy coffee with a zesty kick!

4. Does coffee with lemon taste good?

Many people find that coffee with lemon tastes surprisingly good! The acidity of the lemon complements the rich flavors of the coffee, creating a unique and refreshing beverage. It’s a matter of personal preference, so if you enjoy citrus flavors, it’s definitely worth a try. You might just discover a new favorite way to enjoy your coffee!

Final Thoughts

As you savor each bite of this delightful lemon coffee cake, let the zesty flavors transport you to sunny afternoons and cherished moments. It’s a simple recipe that brings joy and warmth to any gathering. So, gather your loved ones, brew a fresh pot of coffee, and enjoy this rewarding treat that’s sure to brighten your day!
